label: Episode 48
logline: While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 47's public disgrace where Catherine bowed to Juliana and accepted the position of a maid; in private, Catherine sheds her feigned defeat and initiates her counter-plot.

CLIP: episode 48, 1 segment(s), 46s
[00:34.20-00:37.10] CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing): "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
[00:37.30-00:39.00] CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating): "Good. Let them remember it."
[00:39.20-00:43.00] CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory): "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
[00:43.00-00:46.80] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.
[00:43.30-00:46.80] AGNES (Anxious, Whispering): "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
[00:46.80-00:51.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.
[00:47.00-00:51.30] CATHERINE (Confident, Devious): "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
[00:51.50-00:58.20] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
[00:52.00-00:55.00] CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming): "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
[00:55.20-00:58.20] CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding): "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
[00:58.20-01:01.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
[00:58.50-01:00.60] AGNES (Apprehensive): "If someone sees him come to you..."
[01:01.00-01:06.90] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
[01:01.80-01:04.00] CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening): "Then no one sees him."
[01:04.30-01:06.90] CATHERINE (Authoritative): "That is precisely your job tonight."
[01:06.90-01:13.50] CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
[01:07.50-01:09.00] SOUND: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
[01:07.80-01:10.50] CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding): "Send for the priest. Tonight."
[01:10.80-01:13.40] CATHERINE (Firm, Final): "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
[01:13.50-01:16.80] CAMERA: Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.
[01:16.80-01:20.00] CAMERA: Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.
